items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: This tenor man, his name is Cliff Curry, he was a major at the Board of Application... I said, are you nuts? You're going to think you're good. I said, don't come on the next job in that hair.

ctx.x: I've heard of it, yeah. What year was that? Do you remember what year about that was?

Oh, that was in my, I'd say, mid-fifties. This tenor man, his name is Cliff Curry, he was a major at the Board of Application. He was never any hired as a sergeant when he was in the Army, but he had such an important job. So he could give orders and be a major. He was a major. When he was a graduate of Springville, he was a certified public accountant, you know what I mean? He was not out of the ordinary, a talented fellow, nice looking. Used to dye his hair.
